digest.component_or_area: runner.py module size and seam extraction
propositions: runner.py on origin/main grew from ~698 LOC (when story 2682 was authored) to 798 LOC, invalidating the attested <700 target
the LLM-provider-seam stack's split reduces runner.py by 85 lines but lands at 713 LOC, exceeding the <700 criterion despite removing the intended bulk
two candidate seams (_import_pydantic_ai and _pai_check_config) are pinned by ~15 monkeypatch sites across 9 test files, blocking naive relocation without suite-wide refactoring
pydantic-ai import preflight cluster (~40 LOC) was extracted from runner.py to structured_run.py via re-imports to preserve monkeypatch resolution without test edits
after extraction, runner.py reduced from 713 to 680 LOC with real headroom; full test suite (8143 passed) and CI verification passed on the rebased stack
